The '''Wiyentaah crater''' was one of the many craters that covered the surface of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]]. It was the location of the main [[Kallidahin/Legends|Polis Massan]] facility in the [[Polis Massa Asteroid Field]], the [[Polis Massa Research Base]]. The crater was renamed Wiyentaah crater after the lost underground city of [[Wiyentaah/Legends|Wiyentaah]] was discovered beneath the surface of the crater, almost directly under the research station.<ref name="Strongholds" />
